seoTitle: Recipe Scaler: Change Servings and Scale Ingredients
metaDescription: Paste a recipe and scale every quantity from the original to the wanted servings. Handles fractions and ranges. Free.
intro: Multiplies the first quantity on each ingredient line by wanted servings divided by original servings, and prints friendly fractions.
why:
Doubling a recipe by hand means multiplying 1 1/2 and 3/4 in your head. Paste the list and get each line scaled.

It reads whole numbers, decimals, fractions such as 1/2, mixed numbers such as 1 1/2, unicode halves and ranges like 2-3. Units are not converted and cooking times are left alone.

faq.a: No. 48 tsp stays 48 tsp. Use the cooking converter for units.
Often not. Taste and adjust when scaling a lot.

faq.q: What about lines without a number?
